svt_mipi_dsi_host_agent Class Reference

List of all members.

Detailed Description

Defines DSI Host agent with basic UVM components to drive data to the DSI Device.

DSI Host agent contains Active and Passive components. Sequencer and DSI Host Driver are the active components while Monitor works as a passive component. Active components can be disabled using configuration.

Based on the sequences, Sequencer generates different packets and passes it to the DSI Host Driver which drives the data on interface. Monitor is used to monitor the signals on to the interface.

Sequencer is connected to the DSI Host driver with seq_item_port. Two analysis ports has been provided for external usage to get transaction from DSI Host and DSI Monitor.

  function void
 svt_mipi_dsi_host_agent::connect_phase
 (  uvm_phase phase  ) 

Connect phase used to connect all the agent's components. In this phase, sequencer is connected to DSI Host driver with seq_item_port. Analysis port of DSI Host driver is conneted with locally defined analysis port for user purpose. If Monitor is enable, then Analysis port of Monitor is connected with locally defined analysis port for user purpose.

phase - Handle of uvm_phase, which is utlized by the base class and helps in phasing.

 svt_mipi_dsi_host  attribute
 svt_mipi_dsi_host_agent::driver

DSI Host driver is an active component of this agent. It receives packets from sequencer and transmits them to the PHY layer. From the PHY layer those data will be driven on to the interface. It also recieves response packet trasmitted from Device driver.

 svt_mipi_dsi_monitor  attribute
 svt_mipi_dsi_host_agent::monitor

DSI Monitor instance to monitor signals on the interface. It is a passive component of this agent and can be disabled using monitor_enable bit. Monitor shall be disabled only during active configuration.
